resources.string: %1$s neezora ebyandiikwa byawe, ebishushani n\'ebishushani bya sikuriini kurugiirira aha maziina gaabyo n\'ebigambo ebibirimu.
Neeshoma fayiro zaawe aha simu egi, kandi torikwetaaga kwiha kintu kyona aha intaneeti. Tihaine kintu kyona ekirikwoherezibwa aha seva.
Amaziina nigabanza kushomwa, n\'ahabw\'ekyo okusherura nikukora haihi ahonaaho. Okushoma ebigambo ebiri omu byandiikwa byawe, fayiro za PDF n\'ebishushani nikitwara obwire burikukiraho.
Kya mangu. Nikikubaasisa kuzoora fayiro ahabw\'eiziina ryayo.
Ky\'ompora. Nikikubaasisa kuzoora fayiro ahabw\'ebigambo ebihandiikirwemu, otwariiremu ebyandiikwa ebiri omu bishushani.
Sherura fayiro zaawe ahabw\'amaziina gaazo n\'ebigambo ebizirimu
Amaziina nigakora hati, kandi ebigambo bikyashomwa, n\'ahabw\'ekyo fayiro ezindi nizibaasa kuzoorwa.
Sherura neezora fayiro ahabw\'amaziina gaazo n\'ebigambo ebizirimu, byona aha simu egi.

%1$s neesangura entebeekanisa ya fayiro zaawe hati: amaziina gaazo, ebigambo ebiri omu byandiikwa byawe, n'ebyandiikwa ebi yashoma omu bishushani n'eby'ahari sikuriini. Fayiro zaayo ez'akaanya na lipoota z'obuzibu nazo nizisangurwa.

Fayiro zaawe tizirikukwatwaho. Entebeekanisa zaawe nzigumaho, otwariiremu foluda ezi warekire.

%1$s neegaruka erekyera aho kushoma. Sherura neeguma eyereire okuhitsya waatoonya ahari Garukamu.
Betire eri ahansi ya 30%%, n\'ahabw\'ekyo %1$s neehindaho kushoma kubaasa kubiika amaani agasigaireho. Neegumizamu yonyine simu yaatandika kuchaajingwa.
